title: Favourite friends, PC tools and battle fixes
notes: Favourite friends: star a friend on the Friends list and they always sit at the top, online or not, in every sort and in the raid invite list (thanks foxelina!).
PC: “Apply to all boxes” in the wallpaper picker, and one-click HD or Pixel sprites for every Pokémon on the box bar (thanks sato0007!).
Friendship evolutions: a Pokémon that becomes your Good Buddy can take its friendship evolution right away, at any level (Lv 20 still works too).
Settings: “Taskbar button & Alt-Tab” gives Tallgrass a taskbar button and an Alt-Tab entry (Windows).
changes: Wonder Trade takes any Pokémon now, except favourites. Your only one of a species asks first.
Wonder Trades a day: 5, plus 1 for every Gym badge.
The PC always has an empty box waiting at the end: there’s no box limit.
The Professor now pays a flat $100 for common and $150 for uncommon Pokémon (rares, legendaries and specials unchanged), so catching everything no longer beats picking your catches.
fixes: Held items work in battles you fight yourself, including Tower floors: Leftovers, Shell Bell, Life Orb, Rocky Helmet, Loaded Dice, Focus Sash, Metronome and Light Clay (thanks jerichiolol!).
Squad weather (Rain Dance, Sunny Day, Sandstorm, Snowscape and Leader weather) now says so when it starts in auto battles and the Tower, so you can see it working (thanks jerichiolol!).

title: Hotfix: online, Wonder Trade and new finds
notes: Pokémon that couldn’t be found anywhere now live on the islands: Scatterbug and Flabébé (Town), Spewpa and Furfrou (Beach), Vivillon, Minior, Alcremie and Florges (Sky), and Ogerpon as a Legendary on Pyre.
changes: The online count and your friends’ online dots are back and much lighter on the server. They update every couple of minutes.

Wonder Trade never sends you away empty-handed: when nothing in the pool fits you yet, your Pokémon goes in anyway and a Pokémon comes back to your PC as soon as another trainer trades (you get a note).
Tower: Give up asks first, so a misclick can’t end your run (thanks ziemia and sim0100!).
Favourite Pokémon (the star) never go to the Professor: not by auto-send, Send duplicates or a multi-select, and they can’t be released or Wonder Traded until you unfavourite them (thanks Racx!).
fixes: Wonder Trade said “Nothing for you in the pool right now” for everyone since the launch (thanks iwrecked22 and erkumo!).
Events badge: stamps and bounties waiting to be collected show on their tab again, and opening Events goes straight to them (thanks sato0007!).
Windows on a second monitor stay there: after a restart, or a monitor that was asleep, they come back on the monitor you left them on instead of the main one (thanks zeckyboy!).
Log in with Discord: while the login card is up, the rest of your screen (and your other monitors) stays clickable, so the browser login can always be finished (thanks akacmr and ahlizah!).
Use all monitors no longer hides the Windows taskbar (thanks showahei!).
Wild Pokémon can drop held items again (they had stopped since the launch).
Wattrel and 8 other Pokémon no longer show a giant front sprite in battle (thanks BigBoss!).
Connection: a busy server no longer makes every game retry over and over.

title: Codes, events and auto-teams
notes: Redeem codes: Settings → Redeem a code. Codes from the Tallgrass team (Discord, streams, events) give a reward; each trainer can use a code once.

Events: when the Tallgrass team runs an event (better Shiny odds, double EXP or money, a special Mass Outbreak, a Raid Hour with bonus eggs) a banner at the top of your screen shows it with a countdown. Event outbreaks show in Events → Outbreaks for everyone who can reach that island.
Gifts from the Tallgrass team arrive as a gift card; a Pokémon from one wears an Event ribbon.

Auto-team for this island: the AUTO button under your party builds the best team from your whole PC for the island you’re on (its Gym and its wild Pokémon: type matchups, levels, Power and IVs). You see it first and confirm before anything moves; Founder Pokémon stay unless you say so, and your Buddy stays (thanks foxelina!).

Legendaries and bosses can wait for you: Catch rules → Legendaries / Bosses → call me first. A Legendary waits two minutes so you can battle it yourself (your team still never knocks out a Pokémon it’s protecting); a boss waits so you can set up your team first (Fight! or Team first). Default is auto, as before (thanks sato0007!).
fixes: Clamperl: after one Clamperl became a Huntail, the Gorebyss branch stayed locked. Every Clamperl can now pick Huntail or Gorebyss (after a trade, or with a Linking Cord, which asks which one). Every other branching line was checked too (thanks erkumo!).

Poké Ball menu: at Size 1.25× or 1.5×, or on a second monitor, the menu could open past the edge of the screen and couldn’t be clicked. It now always opens inside the screen it’s on, on every side, and panels stay clear of the taskbar (thanks jigen_98!).
